cases.reason: Creates initial and additional replicas; registration checks that each is still present in cluster state.

cases.reason: Creates six PULL replicas and asserts none is elected leader, directly exercising register assertion.
cases.caveat: @Repeat(iterations=2) deliberately yields two successful JUnit runs; preserve repetitions.

cases.reason: Initial and added NRT/TLOG/PULL cores enter register; a healthy core is nonnull at the check.
cases.caveat: Register happens in embedded nodes; wait for async startup and select node actor.

cases.reason: Deletes a leader replica, so synchronous deleteCore waits for core removal and checks callable result.
cases.caveat: Deletion may invoke callback asynchronously before command completes.

cases.caveat: May need command actor coverage; preserve alias maintenance timing.

cases.reason: A valid split reaches the outer owner check but cannot reach the nested changed-owner check without entering a branch that throws.

cases.reason: The coordinator query creates a synthetic collection, but the mapped createException check is entered only when syntheticColl remains null after creation; both outcomes of that nested check throw.

cases.reason: Runs split scenarios including custom ranges; valid child range is tested against parent range.

cases.reason: Updates collections through the HTTP cloud client, invoking distributed update defensive checks; stable leadership takes nonthrowing path.
cases.caveat: This selector is broad, not a direct leader-transition test; verify exact B20 coverage.
